# LaTeX `\rowcolor` Command

The `\rowcolor` command is used to color entire rows in tables. It requires the `xcolor` package with the `table` option.

## Basic Setup

```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
```

## Basic Syntax

```latex
\rowcolor{color}
```

---

## Examples

### Simple Row Coloring

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{document}

\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{yellow} A & B & C \\
\hline
D & E & F \\
\hline
\rowcolor{cyan} G & H & I \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

\end{document}
```

### Alternating Row Colors

```latex
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{gray!30} Header 1 & Header 2 & Header 3 \\
\hline
\rowcolor{white} Row 1 & Data & Data \\
\rowcolor{gray!15} Row 2 & Data & Data \\
\rowcolor{white} Row 3 & Data & Data \\
\rowcolor{gray!15} Row 4 & Data & Data \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
```

### Automatic Alternating Colors

```latex
\rowcolors{2}{gray!25}{white}  % Start at row 2, alternate gray and white

\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
Header 1 & Header 2 & Header 3 \\
\hline
Row 1 & Data & Data \\
Row 2 & Data & Data \\
Row 3 & Data & Data \\
Row 4 & Data & Data \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
```

---

## Custom Colors

```latex
\definecolor{lightblue}{RGB}{173, 216, 230}
\definecolor{lightgreen}{RGB}{144, 238, 144}

\begin{tabular}{|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{lightblue} Name & Value \\
\hline
\rowcolor{lightgreen} Item & 100 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
```

---

## Quick Reference

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `\rowcolor{color}` | Color a single row |
| `\rowcolors{start}{color1}{color2}` | Alternate row colors |
| `\cellcolor{color}` | Color a single cell |
| `\columncolor{color}` | Color entire column |
